name: CodeSignal Hire
summary: CodeSignal Hire is a skills assessment product with a library of certified assessments and AI proctoring. Its pricing page lists Build at $79 a month and Grow at $479 a month on annual billing, and quotes Pro. The comparison table lists AI grading and insights, but the page text does not show which plans include it.

facts.text: The pricing page says CodeSignal offers hundreds of Certified Assessments by skill, role and function.
The Build plan lists AI Proctoring and ID Verification. The Pro plan lists Advanced Fraud Prevention and RBAC.
The comparison table lists AI grading and insights. The text read from the page did not show which plans include it.

plans.name: Build
plans.notes: Listed at $99 a month when billed monthly.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Listed at $599 a month when billed monthly.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: The page lists Pro as custom and tailored to the plan.

hiddenCosts: The Learn and Education suites have separate pricing and are not covered by this profile.
The dollar figures are recorded as shown. The text read from the pricing page does not name the currency.
